Description: Retrieves archive files in pages and supports three retrieval modes. MetadataOnly returns file metadata, WithUrls adds download and view links, and WithData additionally includes inline Base64 data for small files. Sorting is available by CreatedAt, FileName, or FileSize, and the sort order can be Asc or Desc. The fileTypes filter expects content types, for example application/pdf or image/png.

Creates a ZIP archive containing the files for the selected archive record. Use flatten to ignore folder nesting, password to encrypt the ZIP, compression to control ZIP size versus speed, and includeMetadata to embed archive metadata in the bundle.
Summary: Download an archive record as a ZIP bundle.
